events.title: Starting product discovery cycle
events.detail: Scanning recent EU/Spain demand, visual potential, margin, logistics and saturation signals.

events.title: Scanning TikTok product velocity
events.detail: Checking recent pet, automotive, tech and kitchen product velocity for visual products with low return risk.

events.title: Pet-hair niche still has demand, but supply reliability is the risk
events.detail: Pet grooming vacuum, pet hair remover mitt and portable pet products show strong recent view velocity; fulfillment reliability remains a key filter.

events.title: Checking portable pet hydration products
events.detail: Comparing recent TikTok demand with Spain retail pricing and product simplicity.

events.title: Portable pet water bottle has traction but weak differentiation
events.detail: Recent TikTok velocity is strong and the product is simple/non-fragile, but Spain pricing is already highly commoditized, compressing margin and differentiation.

events.title: Testing handheld vacuum sealer candidate
events.detail: Evaluating visual demonstration, pricing and availability for a cordless vacuum sealer with reusable bags.

events.title: Vacuum sealer is visually strong but not ready to promote
events.detail: The shrinking-bag demo is compelling and the category has current momentum, but verified EU dropshipping stock is weak and battery/food-contact compliance adds risk.

events.title: Keep current leader unchanged
events.detail: No newly scanned product clears the current leader on combined demand, visual proof, logistics simplicity, margin potential and risk.

events.title: Discovery cycle complete
events.detail: Watchlist updated internally; no user notification required.

events.title: Consolidation complete
events.detail: Current leader retained; finance and fulfillment are the next gates.

events.title: Pre-GO store architecture complete
events.detail: Storefront spec v1 created and handed off to Creative, SEO and QA.

events.title: Starting pre-GO storefront benchmark
events.detail: Benchmarking premium pet commerce patterns for the current leader before production build.

events.title: Reviewing premium pet bundle patterns
events.detail: Comparing visual hierarchy, routine-led merchandising, use-case coverage, proof and trust placement.

events.title: Routine-led bundle is the strongest storefront model
events.detail: Best pattern is to sell one clear 3-step pet-to-home routine, with proof near the CTA and simple what-is-included guidance.

events.title: Storefront spec v1 created
events.detail: Mobile-first hero, demonstration flow, trust, FAQ, sticky CTA, analytics hooks and performance budgets defined.

events.title: No WebGL/3D for launch v1
events.detail: Real product demonstration video provides more comprehension with lower mobile performance cost.

events.title: Starting fresh EU product scan
events.detail: Rechecking recent demand signals, Spain/EU retail bands, visual demo strength and low-regulation candidates.

events.title: Rechecking September pet-product velocity
events.detail: Reviewing grooming, pet-cleaning and travel-with-pet candidates against the current leader.

events.title: Dog car seat cover is a lower-regulation challenger
events.detail: The category remains active and has a strong dirt/hair before-after demo without electrical compliance, but fit and waterproofing returns need validation.

events.title: Checking EU retail bands for dog car covers
events.detail: Validating target-price fit before supplier economics.

events.title: Dog car cover price band passes
events.detail: Current mainstream references around €39.99-59.95 leave room for a differentiated mid-market offer if landed cost is low enough.

events.title: Testing compression packing cubes
events.detail: Comparing current Spain/EU retail prices, delivery and saturation for a low-regulation travel candidate.

events.title: Packing cubes pass price fit but competition is heavy
events.detail: Current branded references cluster around €35-60, but generic saturation means supplier economics and positioning must be exceptional.

events.title: Checking rising car-accessory candidates
events.detail: Testing foldable windshield sunshade umbrella for visual demo, target retail range and regulatory simplicity.

events.title: Windshield sunshade passes price/demo filters with seasonality risk
events.detail: September data shows the automatic sunshade rising and current EU listings fit the €25-100 band, but universal-fit complaints and seasonality are material risks.

events.title: Leader retained; three challengers strengthened
events.detail: Kit Muda Cero remains #1. Dog car seat cover moves to #2 WATCH; compression packing cubes and windshield sunshade enter the top five pending EU supplier economics.

events.title: Product discovery cycle complete
events.detail: Top-10 and handoffs updated. No challenger clears PROMOTE without verified supplier cost and SLA.

events.title: Starting customer-voice mining cycle
events.detail: Mining objections and return drivers for the current leader and top challengers.

events.title: Testing grooming-tool objections
events.detail: Comparing coat-type suitability, comfort and misuse concerns around slicker brushes.

events.title: Kit Muda Cero promise is too broad
events.detail: Slicker suitability varies by coat/technique and reusable rollers have surface limitations; the offer should explain which tool is for which coat or textile.

events.title: Dog-car-cover return risks concentrated in fit and durability
events.detail: Vehicle fit, clips, zippers, waterproof backing and sliding are the main quality risks to gate at sourcing.

events.title: Sunshade convenience wins, fit and handle durability lose
events.detail: Compact fast deployment is the desired outcome; sizing and structural durability are the key objections.

events.title: Tighten Kit Muda Cero positioning
events.detail: Recommend a coat/surface-specific 3-step routine and remove universal-surface implications from copy.

events.title: Customer Voice cycle complete
events.detail: Five high-impact insights persisted and handed off to Creative, Store Builder and Compliance.
